body.message:
We have been very patient for the past two nights.

Please speak with the owner and arrange for two additional nights free of charge. Instead of leaving on the 17th, we would like to stay until the 19th or 20th, as we have effectively lost two nights of our stay.

The first night was ruined because of the cockroaches, insects, and unsanitary conditions, forcing us to spend most of the night outside the apartment. The second night has been ruined because the alarm system keeps going off and will not stop.

Therefore, we kindly request either two complimentary nights or a full refund for these two nights.

Considering everything that has happened, we also believe a goodwill gesture would be appropriate.

It is now 2:00 AM, and my wife and I are still unable to sleep. This situation has become completely unacceptable and extremely frustrating.

We would appreciate an urgent resolution as soon as possible. Thank you.
